datasets.name: MRBench V2
datasets.unit: one tutoring context with multiple annotated candidate responses
datasets.pilot_use: natural same-context contrasts and independent response labels
datasets.contamination_note: Public since 2024; use for ecological validation, not a fresh contamination-free test.

datasets.name: MathDial
datasets.pilot_use: trajectory contexts and tutor-move-labelled elicitation examples
datasets.contamination_note: Derived from GSM8K and publicly mirrored; never use as the sealed fresh test.

datasets.name: Bridge
datasets.unit: real tutoring excerpt with original and expert-revised response
datasets.pilot_use: natural learner errors and novice/expert response contrasts
datasets.contamination_note: Public since 2023; some excerpts omit the original problem.

rules.redistribution: Keep raw data out of git. Preserve source, license, revision, and content hash.
rules.splitting: Group by source problem or conversation before creating variants.
rules.analysis: Report natural and synthetic estimates separately.
rules.verification: Human-check a stratified sample and every automatic-verifier disagreement.
